(4) [F79Except as provided by this section, in the case of a trial with a jury]no part—
(a) of a statement given under section 31(6)(a), or
(b) of any other information relating to the case for the accused or, if there is
more than one, the case for any of them, which was given in pursuance of a
requirement imposed under section 31,
may be disclosed at a stage in the trial after the jury have been sworn without the
consent of the accused concerned.
